title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
abstract: arXiv:2610.01306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all

translated_title: DAYJOB：一个面向长周期专业工作的基准测试
translated_abstract: 专业工作通常始于一个简短的请求，需要专业人员自己弄清楚需要什么、哪些文档重要，以及请求的前提是否成立。我们推出了DAYJOB，一个由医疗健康领域（50个）和金融领域（80个）专业人士构建的130项任务的基准测试。据估计，医疗健康任务平均需要专业人员13.6小时，金融任务平均需要16.6小时。每个任务都是一个容器化的Harbor环境，配有包含二元评判准则的专家评分标准（每个任务的中位数分别为47.5条和57.5条），由代理式评判器对交付的文件进行评估，只有满足全部准则才算通过。在来自13家开发商的30个模型配置中，表现最强的Claude Opus 5.5通过了24.7%的医疗健康任务尝试和23.9%的金融任务尝试，而中位数配置仅通过0.6%和2.5%。案例研究显示，智能体会接受与记录相矛盾的前提，并将错误的输入带入原本逻辑一致的分析中。我们发布了所有……
tldr: DAYJOB是一个由医疗和金融专业人士构建、包含130项平均耗时13.6至16.6小时的长周期专业工作基准测试，最强模型也仅通过约24%的任务，揭示了当前AI智能体在真实专业工作能力上的巨大差距。
en_tdlr: DAYJOB is a benchmark of 130 long-horizon professional tasks built by healthcare and finance experts, averaging 13.6-16.6 hours each, on which even the strongest model, Claude Opus 5.5, passes only about 24% of tasks, revealing a large gap in current AI agents' ability to handle real professional work.
